name: LlmObservabilityDashboard

states.name: Summary Cards
states.description: Four metric cards at the top of the dashboard showing aggregate LLM usage statistics: Total Cost (formatted as dollars from cents, with provider count subtitle), Total Tokens (input + output with K/M suffixes, with in/out breakdown subtitle), Total Calls (with unique model count subtitle), and Avg Cost/Call (with average duration subtitle when available). These cards give the user an instant overview of LLM spend and usage volume for the selected time range.
states.precondition: LLM analytics data has loaded successfully

states.name: Time Range Selection
states.description: A dropdown selector and refresh button in the dashboard header that controls the time window for all analytics data. Options are 'Last 24 hours' (1d), 'Last 7 days' (7d, default), 'Last 30 days' (30d), and 'All time' (all). Changing the selection triggers a re-fetch of all Tauri-backed queries with the corresponding days parameter. The refresh button manually invalidates all cached queries.

states.name: Cost Charts
states.description: Three cost visualization charts arranged in a responsive grid: (1) Cost Over Time â€” a Recharts LineChart showing daily LLM cost with date on X-axis and dollar amount on Y-axis, with tooltips showing cost, calls, input/output tokens per day; (2) Cost by Model â€” a horizontal BarChart ranking models by total cost descending, with tooltips showing cost, calls, tokens, and avg duration; (3) Cost by Phase â€” a horizontal BarChart breaking down cost by workflow phase (setup/agentic/completion), sorted by cost descending.
states.precondition: LLM analytics data has loaded successfully (not in loading or error state)

states.name: Cost Trends
states.description: A dedicated cost trend chart that fetches its own data independently from the web backend via useCostTrends (fetch API â†’ PostgreSQL). Shows a Recharts LineChart with two lines: 'Daily Cost' (solid line with dots) and '7-Day Average' (dashed line, computed client-side via 7-day rolling window). Displays summary stats above the chart: Total spend, Avg/day cost, and Trend direction (up/down/flat icon). The trend direction compares the average of the last 7 days against the previous 7 days, with a 5% threshold.
states.precondition: Cost trends data has loaded and at least 7 days of data exist

states.name: Provider Latency
states.description: A grouped bar chart showing response time distribution per LLM provider. Each provider has three bars: Avg (primary color), Min (accent color), and Max (secondary color) latency in milliseconds. Includes a Recharts Legend identifying the three series. Tooltips show provider name, avg/min/max latency, and call count.
states.precondition: LLM analytics data has loaded successfully (not in loading or error state)

states.name: Task Run Cost Table
states.description: A sortable table showing per-task-run LLM cost breakdown, limited to the most recent 50 runs. Columns: Task Run (truncated ID with full ID in title attribute), Cost (sortable, default sort descending), Input tokens, Output tokens, Calls (sortable), and Started (sortable, formatted as 'Mon DD, HH:MM'). Sort toggles between ascending and descending when clicking the same column header. An ArrowUpDown icon appears next to the active sort column.
states.precondition: At least one task run with LLM cost data exists

states.name: Dashboard Loading & Error States

requiredElements.text: Run some workflows to start collecting LLM analytics
No task run cost data available

states.description: The dashboard handles three non-data states: (1) Loading â€” a centered spinning RefreshCw icon while any Tauri query is in-flight; (2) Error â€” an AlertTriangle icon with 'Failed to load LLM analytics', the error message text, and a 'Retry' button that triggers refresh; (3) Empty â€” a CreditCard icon with 'No LLM usage data available' and 'Run some workflows to start collecting LLM analytics' when summary is null or total_calls is 0. Individual chart components also have their own empty states when their specific data arrays are empty.

states.name: Data Display
states.description: Assertions verifying that data values are rendered with correct formatting, units, axis labels, and proportional representation across summary cards, charts, and tables.

states.name: Behavior

requiredElements.text: Cost Over Time|Cost by Model|Cost Trends

states.description: Assertions verifying interactive behavior: time range filtering, refresh, chart animations, and tooltip interactions.

states.name: Navigation
states.description: Assertions verifying dashboard accessibility via tab navigation, state persistence, and scroll behavior.

states.name: Element Presence

requiredElements.text: Cost Over Time|Cost by Model|Cost by Phase|Cost Trends|Provider Latency|Task Run Costs

states.description: Assertions verifying that key UI elements are present and visible in the dashboard layout.

states.name: UI Bridge Element Registrations
states.description: The dashboard and its summary-cards subcomponent register elements with the UI Bridge SDK so that currentRouteOnly=true snapshots return the page's interactive content (refresh button, time-range selector, metric cards, charts, task-run table), not just sidebar chrome. Exposes stable element ids that automation workflows can target without depending on rendered text. A `page:llm-analytics` component and a `llm-analytics-root` element are always present; the metric-card and chart registrations require the corresponding data branch to have rendered.
states.precondition: LLM Analytics tab is currently active

description: The LLM Observability Dashboard provides analytics for LLM token usage, cost breakdown, and provider performance. Displays summary metric cards, cost-over-time and cost-by-model charts, phase cost breakdown, provider latency distribution, a 7-day moving average cost trend line, and a per-run cost table. Data sourced via Tauri commands (SQLite) and web API (PostgreSQL) with TanStack Query caching.
